newsitem.title: USA: Pratt Wylce says suspends consulting.
newsitem.headline: Pratt Wylce says suspends consulting.

text.p: Pratt, Wylce & Lords, Ltd said Thursday it temporarily suspended its consulting services as a result of delays in the Securities and Exchange Commission registration process of one of its client companies.

Pratt said the unidentified company was informed Tuesday evening, and Pratt confirmed Wednesday morning, that Pratt's ongoing efforts to obtain full compliance with all SEC regulations were the source of the delays.

Pratt said that to expedite the registration process for all its clients, it is offering to terminate its consulting agreements in return for a "reasonable consideration for services already provided and is recommending alternative sources for those services not fulfilled."
Citing the registration process, Pratt said it will be unable to distribute any additional stock to eholders until further notice.

In the interim, Pratt is reducing its operations to a minimum level until full compliance can be achieved. Once full compliance is achieved, management will review the advisability of resuming its services.
As a result of the resignation of two directors and pursuant to U.S. 1940 Act, the company said it must immediately call a shareholders meeting to elect new directors.
Pratt said that shareholders may be asked to vote on whether to change the nature of its business, and cease being an investment company.
